request.prompt:
ART-DIRECTION REBUILD of this frame. The supplied image is ONLY the composition, story and costume reference. Recreate the scene as a convincing MACRO PHOTOGRAPH OF AN ACTUAL HAND-BUILT THREE-DIMENSIONAL CUT-PAPER MINIATURE SET. The user finds the current image too illustrated: the change in material and physical construction must be dramatic and immediately obvious. Do not retain its illustrated surface, etched detail, stone textures or all-in-focus painted-distance look.
KEEP: vertical 9:16 cinematic framing, exactly one hand of a green-shawl Nasa woman gripping one plain dark vertical staff at left foreground, white cuff, blue underlayer, dark green cut-paper shawl, her face outside frame. A small indigo lagoon lies between close steep highland ridges behind her. No additional person, second hand, extra staff, water contact, ripple, lightning or text. Maintain night blue/olive/ochre palette and solemn atmosphere.
BUILD EVERYTHING FROM REAL PLAIN COLORED PAPER AND CARDSTOCK: near hand constructed from several simple cut and bent ochre paper strips for fingers around a folded rectangular dark-paper staff. Actual thickness on every finger edge, raised overlaps at knuckles, tiny air gaps and believable cast shadows. The green shawl consists of 4–6 broad folded paper panels layered over each other, standing away from the sleeve. Unprinted matte solid-color paper, tiny natural fibers only; zero decorative embossing or painted shading.
PHYSICAL SCENERY: close shoreline built from stacked 1–3 mm die-cut ochre cardstock terraces, visibly separated vertical edges. Mountain rocks are BIG folded angular charcoal cardstock volumes with ridges and seams, not tiny painted rock marks. Reeds and leaves are individual cut paper blades bent out from their stems and casting shadows. Water is a set of wide overlapping dark blue paper ribbons resting at different small heights, showing lift, real thickness and small shadow gaps: not drawn zigzags on a flat plane. Remote mountains are freestanding cut-and-fold scenery pieces placed progressively farther behind one another, with real air between them. Sparse mist is a few thin pale paper ribbons raised between the ridges; no cotton or realistic smoke.
PHOTOGRAPHY: camera INSIDE the miniature world, a macro/close-focus 70mm lens, focus precisely on the hand's assembled paper edges and staff. Foreground extreme corners gently out of focus; lagoon softer; furthest ridges noticeably optically defocused. One raking large soft light from upper-left reveals paper relief through bright cut edges and deep contact shadows, cool blue ambient fill preserves the night mood. Real lens falloff and material tactility. Do not make the background a blurred painting; it is blurred physical cardboard scenery. Editorial cinematic photograph, rich tangible relief throughout. No clay, plastic, wood texture, fabric weave, CGI, vector illustration, digital painting, drawing, paper-texture overlay, engraved pattern, outline strokes or photoreal human skin. The entire image is paper sculpture photographed. Frame is fully immersive edge-to-edge: no outer model boundary, plinth, table, studio gear, display box, labels, caption or watermark.
